title: ID0407555-DC/Si-D/ES - [9yZMnV] Black HMI, Power converter

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407555-DC/Si-D/ES - [9yZMnV] Black HMI, Power converted & AC outlet installation CRM:00796001382
additional_info.body:
Hi Jorge Jose Fernandez Munoz,
The HMI of this charger cannot be replaced without identifying the cause of the error. I request that you check if there is power supply to the HMI and confirm whether you have replaced the DP cable with a new 1.5 m DP cable.
I noticed that this charger is a Si-D high flex model, so the following accessories will be needed for the 20kW power converter:
8EM5903-0AA02-0AA4
8EM5903-0AA02-0AA3
8EM5903-0AA02-0AA8
8EM5903-0AA02-0AA2
8EM5903-0AA02-1AA0
8EM5905-0AA00-2AA8 (if the charger is <300kW)
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
